title: Step by Step to Fairness: Attributing Societal Bias in Task-oriented Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual perturbation of gender-identifying words (e.g., male, female, non-binary) in user utterances to evaluate the difference in task-oriented dialogue response helpfulness using a BLEU-based 'Fairscore' metric.

Counterfactual perturbation of age-related words (e.g., child, adult, senior) in user utterances to evaluate the difference in task-oriented dialogue response helpfulness using a BLEU-based 'Fairscore' metric.

Counterfactual perturbation of race/ethnicity-related words (e.g., American, Hispanic) in user utterances to evaluate the difference in task-oriented dialogue response helpfulness using a BLEU-based 'Fairscore' metric.
